******************************************************************  
* PROGRAM NAME                 : CRYPTVE                         *  
* IMPORTANT FILE               : PASSDOC                         *  
* PROGRAMMER                   : KERESTES                        *  
* DATE OF WRITEN               : SEPT. 2022                      *  
* TECHNOLOGY                   : CICS + COBOL + DB2              *  
******************************************************************  
*                   PROBLEM  DEFINITION                          *  
*                                                                *  
* THIS PROGRAM MAKE THE PASSWORD ENCRYPTATION                    *  
******************************************************************  
* INPUT PARAMETERS:                                              *  
*                                                                *  
* PASSWORD, CLIENTID, ADMINDATE                                  *  
******************************************************************  
* OUTPUT PARAMETERS:                                             *  
*                                                                *  
* CONFIRMATION OF THE ENCRYPTED PASSWORD                         *  
******************************************************************  
                                                                    
******************************************************************  
*                  IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                      *  
******************************************************************  
                                                                    
 IDENTIFICATION                      DIVISION.                      
 PROGRAM-ID. CRYPTVE.                                               
                                                                    
******************************************************************  
*                     ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.                      *  
******************************************************************  
                                                                    
 ENVIRONMENT                               DIVISION.                
                                                                    
*---------------------*                                             
 INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.                                              
*---------------------* 
                                                                  
 FILE-CONTROL. 
                                                                  
     SELECT PASSFILE ASSIGN TO PASSDOC 
     ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL 
     FILE STATUS IS FS-PASSFILE. 
                                                                  
******************************************************************
*                       DATA  DIVISION.                          *
******************************************************************
                                                                  
 DATA                                DIVISION. 
                                                                  
*-------------* 
 FILE SECTION. 
*-------------* 
                                                                  
 FD PASSFILE. 
                                                                  
 01 TOTFILE. 
     02  FILE-USERID    PIC X(8). 
     02  FILE-PASS      PIC X(8). 
     02  FILLER         PIC X(4). 
                                                                  
*------------------------* 
 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 
*------------------------* 
                                                                  
 01  FS-PASSFILE                      PIC X(2). 
     88  FS-PASSFILE-OK               VALUE '00'. 
                                                                  
 01  PASSFILE-KEY                     PIC 9(9) VALUE 0. 
                                                                  
 01  WS-DATE             PIC 9(8). 
                                                                  
 01  WS-USERID1          PIC 9(4) COMP.                             
 01  WS-USERID REDEFINES WS-USERID1 PIC X(2).                       
                                                                    
 01  WS-PASS             PIC 9(4) COMP.                             
 01  WS-PASSWORD REDEFINES WS-PASS PIC X(2).                        
                                                                    
 01  WS-KEY1             PIC 9(4) COMP.                             
 01  WS-KEY REDEFINES WS-KEY1 PIC 9(2).                             
                                                                    
 01  WS-COUNTER1         PIC 9(2).                                  
 01  WS-COUNTER2         PIC 9(2).                                  
                                                                    
 01  WS-MOD1             PIC 9.                                     
                                                                    
 01  WS-CRYPTPASS.                                                  
     02  WS-CRYPTCHAR    PIC X OCCURS 8 TIMES.                      
                                                                    
 01  READ-FLAG           PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.                        
                                                                    
*----------------*                                                  
 LINKAGE SECTION.                                                   
*----------------*                                                  
                                                                    
 01  LS-PASSWORD         PIC X(8).                                  
 01  LS-USERID           PIC X(8).                                  
 01  LS-ADDATE           PIC X(10).                                 
 01  LS-FLAG.                                                       
     02 LS-FLAG-RETURN   PIC X.                                     
     02 LS-FLAG-ERROR    PIC X(4).                                  
*    0 = OK, 1 = INVALID, 2 = ERROR                                 
                                                                    
**************************************************************      
*           PROCEDURE DIVISION WITH LINKAGE SECTION          *      
**************************************************************      
                                                                    
 PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LS-PASSWORD, LS-USERID, LS-ADDATE,        
                                        LS-FLAG.                    
                                                                    
 MAIN-PARA.                                                         
                                                                    
     PERFORM 0100-OPEN-FILE.                                        
     PERFORM 0200-CRYPTPASS.                                        
     PERFORM 0300-COMPARE-PASS.                                     
     PERFORM 0400-CLOSE-FILE.                                       
                                                                    
     GOBACK.                                                        
                                                                    
*****************************************************************   
* 0100-OPEN-FILE.                                               *   
*                                                               *   
* IT OPENS THE FILE TO PUT THE ENCRYPTED PASSWORD.              *   
*****************************************************************   
                                                                    
 0100-OPEN-FILE.                                                    
                                                                    
     OPEN INPUT PASSFILE                                            
                                                                    
     IF NOT FS-PASSFILE-OK                                          
         MOVE 2 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                   
         MOVE FS-PASSFILE TO LS-FLAG-ERROR                          
         GO TO 0400-CLOSE-FILE                                      
     END-IF.                                                        
                                                                    
***************************************************************     
* 0200-CRYPTPASS.                                             *     
*                                                             *     
* IT MAKES THE PASSWORD ENCRYPTATION TO COMPARE WITH THE STORE*     
* ENCRYPTED PASSWORD.                                         *     
***************************************************************     
                                                                    
 0200-CRYPTPASS.                                                    
                                                                    
     MOVE LS-USERID(6:3) TO PASSFILE-KEY                            
     ADD 1 TO PASSFILE-KEY                                          
     MOVE LS-ADDATE(1:4) TO WS-DATE(1:4)                            
     MOVE LS-ADDATE(6:2) TO WS-DATE(5:2)                            
     MOVE LS-ADDATE (9:2) TO WS-DATE(7:2)                           
                                                                    
     INITIALIZE WS-CRYPTPASS.                                       
                                                                    
     COMPUTE WS-KEY = FUNCTION RANDOM (WS-DATE) * 1000              
                                                                    
     MOVE LS-USERID(1:4) TO WS-USERID                               
                                                                    
     PERFORM WITH TEST BEFORE VARYING WS-COUNTER1 FROM 1 BY 1       
                        UNTIL WS-COUNTER1 > 8 OR                    
                        LS-PASSWORD(WS-COUNTER1:1) = SPACE          
                                                                    
         PERFORM WITH TEST AFTER VARYING WS-COUNTER2 FROM           
                               WS-COUNTER1 BY 1 UNTIL               
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'40'  AND       
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'10'  AND       
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'00'  AND       
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'30'  AND       
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'20'            
                                                                    
         COMPUTE WS-MOD1 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-COUNTER2 3)              
                                                                    
         MOVE LS-PASSWORD(WS-COUNTER1:2) TO WS-PASSWORD             
         MOVE LS-USERID(WS-COUNTER1:2) TO WS-USERID                 
                                                                    
         EVALUATE WS-MOD1                                           
            WHEN 0                                                  
                COMPUTE WS-KEY1 = WS-PASS * WS-KEY1                 
                                                                    
                MOVE WS-KEY1 TO WS-PASS                             
                MOVE WS-PASSWORD(2:1) TO WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1)  
                                                                    
            WHEN 1                                                    
                COMPUTE WS-USERID1 = WS-PASS * WS-USERID1             
                                                                      
                MOVE WS-USERID(2:1) TO WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1)      
                                                                      
            WHEN 2                                                    
             COMPUTE  WS-KEY1 = WS-PASS * WS-USERID1 * WS-KEY1        
                                                                      
                MOVE WS-KEY1 TO WS-PASS                               
                MOVE WS-PASSWORD(2:1) TO WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1)    
                                                                      
         END-EVALUATE                                                 
                                                                      
         END-PERFORM                                                  
                                                                      
     END-PERFORM.                                                     
                                                                      
*****************************************************************     
* 0300-COMPARE-PASS                                             *     
*                                                               *     
* IT MAKES THE COMPARATION BETWEEN THE STORED PASSWORD AND THE  *     
* PASSWORD ENCRYPTED BY THIS PROGRAM.                           *     
*****************************************************************     
                                                                      
 0300-COMPARE-PASS.                                                   
                                                                      
     DISPLAY WS-CRYPTPASS                                             
     DISPLAY LS-USERID                                                
                                                                      
     MOVE 9 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                         
                                                                      
     READ PASSFILE                                                    
         AT END MOVE 'Y' TO READ-FLAG                                 
     END-READ                                                         
                                                                      
     IF NOT FS-PASSFILE-OK                                            
        MOVE 2 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                    
        MOVE FS-PASSFILE TO LS-FLAG-ERROR                           
        GO TO 0400-CLOSE-FILE                                       
     END-IF                                                         
                                                                    
     PERFORM UNTIL READ-FLAG = 'Y' OR NOT FS-PASSFILE-OK            
        IF LS-USERID = FILE-USERID                                  
           MOVE 'Y' TO READ-FLAG                                    
           MOVE 0 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                 
        ELSE                                                        
           READ PASSFILE                                            
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO READ-FLAG                         
           END-READ                                                 
        END-IF                                                      
     END-PERFORM                                                    
                                                                    
     IF LS-FLAG-RETURN = 0                                          
        IF WS-CRYPTPASS NOT = FILE-PASS                             
           MOVE 1 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                 
        END-IF                                                      
     ELSE                                                           
        IF FS-PASSFILE-OK                                           
           MOVE 1 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                 
        ELSE                                                        
           MOVE 2 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                 
           MOVE FS-PASSFILE TO LS-FLAG-ERROR                        
           GO TO 0400-CLOSE-FILE                                    
        END-IF                                                      
     END-IF.                                                        
                                                                    
***************************************************************     
* 0400-CLOSE-FILE                                             *     
*                                                             *     
* IT CLOSES THE PS FILE                                       *     
***************************************************************     
                                                                    
  0400-CLOSE-FILE. 
                                                                  
     CLOSE PASSFILE 
                                                                  
     IF NOT FS-PASSFILE-OK 
        MOVE 2 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN 
        MOVE FS-PASSFILE TO LS-FLAG-ERROR 
     END-IF.

**************************************************************** 
* PROGRAM NAME                 : LOGIN                         * 
* IMPORTANT FILE               : DB2 TABLE EMPLO, CRYPT FILE   * 
* PROGRAMMER                   : KERESTES                      * 
* DATE OF WRITEN               : SEPT. 2022                    * 
* TECHNOLOGY                   : CICS + COBOL + DB2            * 
**************************************************************** 
*                   PROBLEM  DEFINITION                        * 
*                                                              * 
*   RECEIVE USERID AND PASSWORD FROM USER VERIFY THE PASSWORD  * 
*         AND CHOSE THE CORRECT MAP TO CALL BY XCTL            * 
**************************************************************** 
* INPUT PARAMETERS:                                            * 
*                                                              * 
* USERID AND PASSWORD BY USER                                  * 
**************************************************************** 
* OUTPUT PARAMETERS:                                           * 
*                                                              * 
* CALL THE COMPATIBLE MAP WITH THE EMPLOYEE DEPARTMENT         * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                 
**************************************************************** 
*                  IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                    * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                 
 IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. 
 PROGRAM-ID. LOGIN. 
                                                                 
**************************************************************** 
*                       DATA DIVISION.                         * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                 
 DATA DIVISION. 
                                                                 
*------------------------* 
 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 
*------------------------* 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                      MAPS CICS COPY                          * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 COPY LOGINMP. 
 COPY DFHAID. 
 COPY DFHBMSCA. 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                      SQL DECLARATION.                        * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
     EXEC SQL 
         INCLUDE EMPLO 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
     EXEC SQL 
         INCLUDE SQLCA 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                        WS VARIABLES                          * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 01  WS-TSTAMP                    PIC S9(15) COMP-3. 
                                                                  
 01  WS-DATE                      PIC X(10). 
 01  WS-TIME. 
     02 WS-HOUR                   PIC 9(2). 
     02 FILLER                    PIC X(1). 
     02 WS-MINUTE                 PIC 9(2). 
     02 FILLER                    PIC X(1). 
     02 WS-SECOND                 PIC 9(2). 
                                                                     
 01  WS-COMMAREA.                                                    
     02 TRANSACTION               PIC X(4).                          
     02 USER-ID                   PIC X(8).                          
                                                                     
 01  WS-USERID                    PIC X(8).                          
 01  WS-PASSWORD                  PIC X(8).                          
 01  WS-ADMIDATE                  PIC X(10).                         
 01  WS-FLAG-LS.                                                     
     02 WS-FLAG-RETURN            PIC X.                             
     02 WS-FLAG-ERROR             PIC X(10).                         
 01  WS-DEPT                      PIC S9(9) COMP.                    
                                                                     
 01  SUBPROGRAM                   PIC X(8).                          
                                                                     
***************************************************************      
*                    PROCEDURE DIVISION.                      *      
***************************************************************      
                                                                     
 PROCEDURE DIVISION.                                                 
                                                                     
***************************************************************      
* MAIN-PARA.                                                  *      
*                                                             *      
* THIS PROGRAM WORKS WITH A PSEUDO-CONVERSATION METHOD.       *      
* THE MAIN PARAGRAPH SET THE PROCEDURE FLOW WHICH CONTROLS THE*      
* LOGIN MAP.                                                  *      
***************************************************************      
                                                                     
 MAIN-PARA.                                                          
                                                                     
     IF EIBCALEN = 0                                                 
         MOVE '                 WELCOME TO COBOL AIRLINES SYSTEM'    
                                     TO MSG1O                        
         PERFORM 0100-GET-TIME                                       
         PERFORM 0110-GIVING-TIME                                    
         PERFORM 0200-SEND-MAP                                       
         PERFORM 0300-RETURN-CICS                                    
     ELSE                                                            
         MOVE SPACE TO MSG1O                                         
         MOVE SPACE TO MSG2O                                         
         PERFORM 0400-RECEIVE-MAP                                    
         PERFORM 0500-PROCESS-LOGIN                                  
         PERFORM 0100-GET-TIME                                       
         PERFORM 0110-GIVING-TIME                                    
         MOVE SPACE TO USERIDO                                       
         MOVE SPACE TO PASSWO                                        
         PERFORM 0200-SEND-MAP                                       
         PERFORM 0300-RETURN-CICS.                                   
     END-IF                                                          
                                                                     
***************************************************************      
* 0100-GET-TIME.                                              *      
*                                                             *      
* FOR GET THE TIME WE CAN UTILISE THE CICS METHOD OR THE COBOL*      
* METHOD IF THE FUNCTION CURRENT-TIME. BUT HERE WE CHOSE THE  *      
* THE CICS METHOD.                                            *      
***************************************************************      
                                                                     
 0100-GET-TIME.                                                      
                                                                     
     EXEC CICS                                                       
         ASKTIME                                                     
         ABSTIME(WS-TSTAMP)                                          
     END-EXEC                                                        
                                                                     
     EXEC CICS                                                       
         FORMATTIME                                                  
         ABSTIME(WS-TSTAMP)                                          
         DATESEP('/')                                                
         DDMMYYYY(WS-DATE)                                           
     END-EXEC                                                        
                                                                 
     EXEC CICS 
         FORMATTIME 
         ABSTIME(WS-TSTAMP) 
         TIMESEP(':') 
         TIME(WS-TIME) 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                 
*************************************************************** 
* 0110-GIVING-TIME.                                           * 
*                                                             * 
* AFTER GETTING THE TIME ITS NECESSARY TO TRANSFER THIS INFO  * 
* TO THE LOGIN MAP ITSELF                                     * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                 
 0110-GIVING-TIME. 
                                                                 
     IF WS-HOUR = 23 
        MOVE ZEROS TO WS-HOUR 
     ELSE 
        ADD 1 TO WS-HOUR. 
     END-IF 
                                                                 
     MOVE WS-TIME TO LHOURO 
     MOVE WS-DATE TO LDATEO. 
                                                                 
*************************************************************** 
* 0200-SEND-MAP.                                              * 
*                                                             * 
* SEND MAP PROCEDURE IS IMPORTANTE TO CHANGE INFORMATIONS WITH* 
* THE USER AND IN THE PSEUDO CONVERSATION METHOD.             * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                 
 0200-SEND-MAP. 
                                                                 
     EXEC CICS 
         SEND MAP('LOGON') MAPSET('LOGINMP') ERASE 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0300-RETURN-CICS.                                           * 
*                                                             * 
* RETURN LETS THE PROGRAM FREE TO RECEIVE OTHER INFORMATIONS  * 
* FROM ANOTHER USERS.                                         * 
* THE COMMUNICATION-AREA IS USED TO SEND INFORMATION BETWEEN  * 
* MAPS.                                                       * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0300-RETURN-CICS. 
                                                                  
     EXEC CICS 
         RETURN TRANSID ('LOGP') 
         COMMAREA(TRANSACTION) 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0400-RECEIVE-MAP.                                           * 
*                                                             * 
* IT RECEIVES THE USER INFORMATION TO BE PROCESSED            * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0400-RECEIVE-MAP. 
                                                                  
     EXEC CICS 
         RECEIVE MAP('LOGON') MAPSET('LOGINMP') 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0500-PROCESS-LOGIN.                                         * 
*                                                             * 
* IN THE LOGIN MAP ITS NECESSARY TO VERIFY THE LOGIN AND THE  * 
* PASSWORD, IF THEY ARE CORRECT THE PROGRAM WILL VERIFY WHICH * 
* DEPARTMENT THE EMPLOYEE BELONGS TO SEND HIM TO THE CORRECT  * 
* MAP                                                         * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0500-PROCESS-LOGIN. 
                                                                  
     PERFORM 0510-GET-LOGIN. 
     PERFORM 0520-PROCESS-DATA. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0510-GET-LOGIN.                                             * 
*                                                             * 
* THIS PARAGRAPH GETS THE USERID AND THE PASSWORD AND VERIFY  * 
* IF THEY ARE CORRECT. FOR GET MORE INFORMATIONS ABOUT THE    * 
* CRYPTOGRAPHY METHOD GO TO THE CRYPTO PROGRAM CALL HERE.     * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0510-GET-LOGIN. 
                                                                  
     MOVE USERIDI TO WS-USERID 
     MOVE PASSWI TO WS-PASSWORD 
                                                                  
     EXEC SQL 
         SELECT ADMIDATE, DEPTID 
         INTO :WS-ADMIDATE, :WS-DEPT 
         FROM EMPLO 
         WHERE EMPID = :WS-USERID 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
     EVALUATE SQLCODE 
        WHEN 0 
            MOVE 1 TO WS-FLAG-RETURN. 
            MOVE 'CRYPTVE' TO SUBPROGRAM 
            CALL SUBPROGRAM USING WS-PASSWORD, WS-USERID, WS-ADMID
                                               WS-FLAG-LS. 
        WHEN 100 
            MOVE 1 TO WS-FLAG-RETURN.                                  
        WHEN OTHER                                                     
            MOVE 2 TO WS-FLAG-RETURN.                                  
     ELSE                                                              
                                                                       
***************************************************************        
* 0520-PROCESS-DATA.                                          *        
*                                                             *        
* THIS PARAGRAPH ANALYSE THE WS-FLAG-RETURN. THE 0 MEANS      *        
* USERID AND PASSWORD ARE OK. 1 USERID OR PASSOWERD INVALID   *        
* 2 ANOTHER ERROR OCCURRED.                                   *        
***************************************************************        
                                                                       
 0520-PROCESS-DATA.                                                    
                                                                       
     EVALUATE WS-FLAG-RETURN                                           
        WHEN 0                                                         
            EVALUATE WS-DEPT                                           
               WHEN 1                                                  
                   MOVE USERIDI TO USER-ID                             
                   MOVE 'THE CEO MAP IS NOT AVAIBLE YET' TO MSG1O      
               WHEN 2 OR 3 OR 4                                        
                   MOVE USERIDI TO USER-ID                             
                   MOVE 'THE CREW MAP IS NOT AVAIBLE YET' TO MSG1O     
               WHEN 5                                                  
                   MOVE USERIDI TO USER-ID                             
                   MOVE 'THE HR MAP IS NOT AVAIBLE YET' TO MSG1O       
               WHEN 6                                                  
                   MOVE USERIDI TO USER-ID                             
                   MOVE 'THE IT MAP IS NOT AVAIBLE YET' TO MSG1O       
               WHEN 7                                                  
                   EXEC CICS XCTL                                      
                      PROGRAM('SRCHFLI')                               
                      COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)                            
                      LENGTH(12)                                       
               WHEN 8 
                   MOVE USERIDI TO USER-ID 
                   MOVE 'THE LAWYER MAP IS NOT AVAIBLE YET' 
                                                       TO MSG1O 
               WHEN 9 
                   MOVE USERIDI TO USER-ID 
                   MOVE 'THE SCHEDULE MAP IS NOT AVAIBLE YET' 
                                                       TO MSG1O 
            END-EVALUATE 
        WHEN 1 
            MOVE 'PASSWORD OR USERID INCORRECT.' TO MSG1O. 
        WHEN 2 
        MOVE 'COMMUNICATION ERROR IN THE SYSTEM CALL THE IT DEPT'
                                TO MSG1O 
            MOVE 'COMMUNICATE THE FOLLOW CODE ERROR: ' 
                                TO MSG2O 
            MOVE WS-FLAG-ERROR TO MSG2O(37:10) 
     END-EVALUATE.

**************************************************************** 
* PROGRAM NAME                 : SELLCOB1                      * 
* IMPORTANT FILE               : DB2 TABLE PASSENGERS, FLIGHT  * 
* PROGRAMMER                   : KERESTES                      * 
* DATE OF WRITEN               : OCT. 2022                     * 
* TECHNOLOGY                   : CICS + COBOL + DB2            * 
**************************************************************** 
*                   PROBLEM  DEFINITION                        * 
*                                                              * 
* SEARCH A FLIGHT AND A PASSENGERS TO REALISE A SELL           * 
**************************************************************** 
* INPUT PARAMETERS:                                            * 
*                                                              * 
* CLIENTID, FLIGHTNUM, DATE, AND PASSENGERS NUMBERS            * 
**************************************************************** 
* OUTPUT PARAMETERS:                                           * 
*                                                              * 
* CALL SELLMAP2 TO FINALIZE THE SELL                           * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                  IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                    * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. 
 PROGRAM-ID. SELLCOB1. 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                       DATA DIVISION.                         * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 DATA DIVISION. 
                                                                  
*------------------------* 
 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 
*------------------------* 
***************************************************************         
*                      MAPS CICS COPY                         *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 COPY SELLMS.                                                           
 COPY DFHAID.                                                           
 COPY DFHBMSCA.                                                         
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
*                       WS VARIABLES                          *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 01  WS-COMMAREA                                                        
     02 WS-TRANS                    PIC X(4).                           
     02 WS-USER-ID                  PIC X(8).                           
     02 WS-FLIGHTID                 PIC 9(9).
     02 WS-CLIID                    PIC 9(6).                           
     02 WS-FNUM                     PIC X(6).                           
     02 WS-DAIR                     PIC X(3).                           
     02 WS-LAIR                     PIC X(3).                           
     02 WS-FDATE                    PIC X(10).                          
     02 WS-PASSN                    PIC 9(1).                           
     02 WS-PRICE                    PIC 9(5)V9(2).                      
     02 WS-TPRICE                   PIC 9(7)V9(2).                      
                                                                        
 01  WS-PRICEV                      PIC 9(5)V9(2).                      
 01  WS-TOTPRICE                    PIC 9(7)V9(2).                      
 
 01  EDIT-PRICE1 REDEFINES WS-PRICEV PIC $$$$9.99.                                                                       
 01  EDIT-PRICE REDEFINES WS-TOTPRICE PIC $$$$$$9.99.                   
                                                                        
 01  WS-FLAG                        PIC X VALUE 'N'.                    
 01  WS-FLAG-MOUV                   PIC X VALUE 'N'.                    
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
*                    DATE AND TIME CICS                       *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 01  WS-TSTAMP                    PIC S9(15) COMP-3.                    
                                                                        
 01  WS-DATE                      PIC X(10).                            
 01  WS-TIME.                                                           
     02 WS-HOUR                   PIC 9(2).                             
     02 FILLER                    PIC X(1).                             
     02 WS-MINUTE                 PIC 9(2).                             
     02 FILLER                    PIC X(1).                             
     02 WS-SECOND                 PIC 9(2).                             
                                                                        
*****************************************************************       
*                       SQL DECLARATION                         *       
*****************************************************************       
                                                                        
     EXEC SQL                                                           
         INCLUDE FLIGHT                                                 
     END-EXEC                                                           
                                                                        
     EXEC SQL                                                           
         INCLUDE PASSENG                                                
     END-EXEC                                                           
                                                                        
     EXEC SQL                                                           
         INCLUDE SQLCA                                                  
     END-EXEC                                                           
                                                                        
*----------------*                                                      
 LINKAGE SECTION.                                                       
*----------------*                                                      
                                                                        
 01  DFHCOMMAREA.                                                       
     02 TRANSACTION     PIC X(4).                                       
     02 USER-ID         PIC X(8).       
     02 COMM-FLIGHTID   PIC 9(9).                                
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
*                      PROCEDURE DIVISION.                    *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 PROCEDURE DIVISION.                                                   
                                                                       
*****************************************************************      
* MAIN-PARA.                                                    *      
*                                                               *      
* THIS PROGRAM WORKS WITH A PSEUDO-CONVERSATION METHOD.         *      
* THE MAIN PARAGRAPH SET THE PROCEDURE FLOW WHICH CONTROLS THE  *      
* SRCHLI MAP.                                                   *      
*****************************************************************      
                                                                       
 MAIN-PARA.                                                            
                                                                       
     IF EIBCALEN = 0                                                   
         PERFORM 0100-GET-DFHCOMMAREA                                  
         PERFORM 0200-GET-TIME                                         
         PERFORM 0210-GIVING-TIME                                      
         PERFORM 0310-MOVE-SPACE                                       
         PERFORM 0300-SEND-MAP                                         
         PERFORM 0400-RETURN-CICS                                      
     ELSE                                                              
         MOVE SPACE TO MSG1O                                           
         MOVE SPACE TO MSG2O                                           
         PERFORM 0500-RECEIVE-MAP                                      
         PERFORM 0100-GET-DFHCOMMAREA                                  
         PERFORM 0510-VERIFY-EIBAID                                    
         PERFORM 0610-VERIFY-SPACE                                     
                                                                       
         IF WS-FLAG = 'N'                                              
                                                                       
            PERFORM 0600-PROCESS-DATA                                  
                                                                       
         END-IF                                                        
                                                                       
         PERFORM 0200-GET-TIME                                         
         PERFORM 0210-GIVING-TIME                                      
         PERFORM 0300-SEND-MAP                                         
         PERFORM 0400-RETURN-CICS                                      
                                                                        
         MOVE 'N' TO WS-FLAG                                            
     END-IF.                                                            
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0100-GET-DFHCOMMAREA                                        *         
*                                                             *         
* MOVE USER-ID FROM DFHCOMMAREA TO WS-USERID.                 *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0100-GET-DFHCOMMAREA.                                                  
                                                                        
     MOVE USER-ID TO WS-USER-ID 
     MOVE WS-USER-ID TO USERIDO                                        
     MOVE EIBTRMID TO WS-TERMINAL
     MOVE WS-TERMINAL TO TERMO
     MOVE COMM-FLIGHTID TO WS-FLIGHTID.                                       
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0200-GET-TIME.                                              *         
*                                                             *         
* FOR GET THE TIME WE CAN UTILISE THE CICS METHOD OR THE COBOL*         
* METHOD IF THE FUNCTION CURRENT-TIME. BUT HERE WE CHOSE THE  *         
* THE CICS METHOD.                                            *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0200-GET-TIME.                                                         
                                                                        
     EXEC CICS                                                          
         ASKTIME                                                        
         ABSTIME(WS-TSTAMP)                                             
     END-EXEC                                                           
                                                                        
     EXEC CICS                                                          
         FORMATTIME                                                     
         ABSTIME(WS-TSTAMP)                                             
         DATESEP('/')                                                   
         DDMMYYYY(WS-DATE)                                              
     END-EXEC                                                           
                                                                        
     EXEC CICS                                                          
         FORMATTIME                                                     
         ABSTIME(WS-TSTAMP)                                             
         TIMESEP(':')                                                   
         TIME(WS-TIME)                                                  
     END-EXEC.                                                          
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0210-GIVING-TIME.                                           *         
*                                                             *         
* AFTER GETTING THE TIME ITS NECESSARY TO TRANSFER THIS INFO  *         
* TO THE LOGIN MAP ITSELF                                     *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0210-GIVING-TIME.                                                      
                                                                        
     IF WS-HOUR = 23                                                    
        MOVE ZEROS TO WS-HOUR                                           
     ELSE                                                               
        ADD 1 TO WS-HOUR.                                               
     END-IF                                                             
                                                                        
     MOVE WS-TIME TO LHOURO                                             
     MOVE WS-DATE TO LDATEO.                                            
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0300-SEND-MAP.                                              *         
*                                                             *         
* SEND MAP PROCEDURE IS IMPORTANTE TO CHANGE INFORMATIONS WITH*         
* THE USER AND IN THE PSEUDO CONVERSATION METHOD.             *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0300-SEND-MAP.                                                         
                                                                        
     EXEC CICS                                                          
         SEND MAP('SELLMP') MAPSET('SELLMS') ERASE                      
     END-EXEC.                                                          
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0310-MOVE-SPACE                                             *         
*                                                             *         
* IT MOVE SPACE TO THE MAP'S VARIABLES. IT IS IMPORTANTE TO   *         
* VERIFY IF ANY INFORMATION WAS INSERT IN IT.                 *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0310-MOVE-SPACE.                                                       
                                                                        
     MOVE SPACE TO CLIIDI                                               
     MOVE SPACE TO FNUMI                                                
     MOVE SPACE TO PASSN.                                               
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0400-RETURN-CICS.                                           *         
*                                                             *         
* RETURN LETS THE PROGRAM FREE TO RECEIVE OTHER INFORMATIONS  *         
* FROM ANOTHER USERS.                                         *         
* THE COMMUNICATION-AREA IS USED TO SEND INFORMATION BETWEEN  *         
* MAPS.                                                       *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0400-RETURN-CICS.                                                      
                                                                        
     EXEC CICS                                                          
         RETURN TRANSID ('SEL1')                                        
         COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)                                          
     END-EXEC.                                                          
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0500-RECEIVE-MAP.                                           *         
*                                                             *         
* IT RECEIVES THE USER INFORMATION TO BE PROCESSED            *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0500-RECEIVE-MAP.                                                      
                                                                        
     EXEC CICS                                                          
         RECEIVE MAP('SELLMP') MAPSET('SELLMS')                         
     END-EXEC.                                                          
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0510-VERIFY-EIBAID                                          *         
*                                                             *         
* IT CHECKS IF THE USER PRESS ANY FKEY WHICH IS REALATED WITH *         
* ANOTHER MAP OR FUNCTION.                                    *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0510-VERIFY-EIBAID.                                                    
                                                                        
     EVALUATE EIBAID                                                    
        WHEN DFHPF3                                                     
                                                                        
            EXEC CICS XCTL                                              
               PROGRAM('LOGIN')                                         
               COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)                                    
               LENGTH(12)                                               
            END-EXEC                                                    
                                                                        
        WHEN DFHPF4                                                     
                                                                        
            EXEC CICS XCTL                                              
               PROGRAM('SRCHFLY')                                       
               COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)                                    
               LENGTH(12)                                               
            END-EXEC                                                    
                                                                        
        WHEN DFHPF5                                                     
                                                                        
            EXEC CICS XCTL                                              
               PROGRAM('SRCHTKT')                                       
               COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)                                    
               LENGTH(12)                                               
            END-EXEC                                                    
                                                                        
        WHEN DFHPF6                                                     
                                                                        
            MOVE 'THIS IS THE CURRENT MAP' TO MSG1O                     
                                                                        
        WHEN DFHPF7                                                     
                                                                        
            MOVE 'THIS MAP IS NOT READY YET' TO MSG1O                   
                                                                        
        WHEN DFHPF10                                                    
                                                                        
            MOVE 'THIS IS THE CURRENT FUNCTION' TO MSG1O                
                                                                        
        WHEN DFHPF12                                                    
                                                                        
            IF WS-FLAG-MOUV = 'Y'                                       
                                                                        
               MOVE CLIIDI TO WS-CLIID                                  
               MOVE FNUMI TO WS-FNUM                                    
               MOVE FDATEI TO WS-FDATE                                  
               MOVE SDAIRI TO WS-DAIR                                   
               MOVE SLAIRI TO WS-LAIR                                   
               MOVE PASSNI TO WS-PASSN                                  
               MOVE SPRICEI TO WS-PRICE                                 
               MOVE STPRICEI TO WS-TPRICE                               
                                                                        
               EXEC CICS XCTL                                           
                  PROGRAM('SELLCOB2')                                   
                  COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)                                 
                  LENGTH(66)                                            
               END-EXEC                                                 
                                                                        
            ELSE                                                        
                                                                        
               MOVE 'YOU NEED TO MAKE A VAIBLE REASEARC BEFORE GO       
                    TO THE SELL SCREEN' TO MSG1O                        
                                                                        
            END-IF                                                      
                                                                        
     END-EVALUATE.                                                      
                                                                        
*************************************************************           
* 0600-PROCESS-DATA                                         *           
*                                                           *           
* THE PROGRAM GET THE INFORMATION FROM THE TABLE FLIGHT AND *           
* PASSENGERS                                                *           
*************************************************************           
                                                                        
 0600-PROCESS-DATA.                                                     
                                                                        
     MOVE CLIIDI TO PA-CLIENTID                                         
     MOVE FNUMI TO FLIGHTNUM                                            
     MOVE FDATEI TO FLIGHTDATE                                          
                                                                        
     EXEC SQL                                                           
         SELECT FIRSTNAME, LASTNAME                                     
         INTO :PA-FIRSTNAME_TEXT, : PA-LASTNAME_TEXT                    
         FROM PASSENGERS                                                
         WHERE CLIENTID = :PA-CLIENTID                                  
     END-EXEC                                                           
                                                                        
     EVALUATE SQLCODE                                                   
                                                                        
        WHEN 0                                                          
                                                                        
            CONTINUE                                                    
                                                                        
        WHEN 100

****************************************************************

* DATE OF WRITEN               : SEPT. 2022                    * 
* TECHNOLOGY                   : CICS + COBOL + DB2            * 
**************************************************************** 
*                   PROBLEM  DEFINITION                        * 
*                                                              * 
* SEARCH A FLIGHT ACCORDING TO INFORMATIONS ENTRED BY THE USER * 
**************************************************************** 
* INPUT PARAMETERS:                                            * 
*                                                              * 
* FLIGHTNUM, DEPARTURE AIRPORT, ARRIVAL AIRPORT, DATE          * 
**************************************************************** 
* OUTPUT PARAMETERS:                                           * 
*                                                              * 
* FLIGHT AVAIBLES ACCORDING TO THE REASEARCH                   * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                  IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                    * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. 
 PROGRAM-ID. SRCHFLY. 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                       DATA DIVISION.                         * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 DATA DIVISION. 
                                                                  
*------------------------* 
 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 
*------------------------*                                              
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
*                      MAPS CICS COPY                         *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 COPY SRCHFLI.                                                          
 COPY DFHAID.                                                           
 COPY DFHBMSCA.                                                         
                                                                        
*****************************************************************       
*                       SQL DECLARATION                         *       
*****************************************************************       
                                                                        
     EXEC SQL                                                           
         INCLUDE FLIGHT                                                 
     END-EXEC.                                                          
                                                                        
     EXEC SQL                                                           
         INCLUDE SQLCA                                                  
     END-EXEC.                                                          
                                                                        
*****************************************************************       
*                          SQL CURSORS                          *       
*****************************************************************       
                                                                        
*----*                                                                  
*CSR1*                                                                  
*----*                                                                  
                                                                        
     EXEC SQL                                                           
         DECLARE CSR1 CURSOR FOR                                        
         SELECT FLIGHTDATE, DEPTIME, ARRTIME, TOTPASS,                  
                FLIGHTNUM, AIRPORTDEP, AIRPORTARR                       
         FROM FLIGHT                                                    
         WHERE FLIGHTDATE >= :WS-EDIT-DATE AND FLIGHTNUM > :FNUMI       
         FOR FETCH ONLY                                              
     END-EXEC                                                        
                                                                     
*-----*                                                              
*CSR10*                                                              
*-----*                                                              
                                                                     
     EXEC SQL                                                        
         DECLARE CSR10 CURSOR FOR                                    
         SELECT FLIGHTDATE, DEPTIME, ARRTIME, TOTPASS,               
                FLIGHTNUM, AIRPORTDEP, AIRPORTARR                    
         FROM FLIGHT                                                 
         WHERE FLIGHTDATE = :FDATEI                                  
         FOR FETCH ONLY                                              
     END-EXEC                                                        
                                                                     
*-----*                                                              
*CSR11*                                                              
*-----*                                                              
                                                                     
     EXEC SQL                                                        
         DECLARE CSR11 CURSOR FOR                                    
         SELECT FLIGHTDATE, DEPTIME, ARRTIME, TOTPASS,               
                FLIGHTNUM, AIRPORTDEP, AIRPORTARR                    
         FROM FLIGHT                                                 
         WHERE FLIGHTDATE = :FDATEI AND FLIGHTNUM = :FNUMI           
         FOR FETCH ONLY                                              
     END-EXEC                                                        
                                                                     
*------*                                                             
*CSR100*                                                             
*------*                                                             
                                                                     
     EXEC SQL                                                        
         DECLARE CSR100 CURSOR FOR                                   
         SELECT FLIGHTDATE, DEPTIME, ARRTIME, TOTPASS,               
                FLIGHTNUM, AIRPORTDEP, AIRPORTARR                   
         FROM FLIGHT                                                
         WHERE FLIGHTDATE = :FDATEI AND AIRPORTDEP = :DAIRI         
         FOR FETCH ONLY                                             
     END-EXEC                                                       
                                                                    
*-------*                                                           
*CSR1000*                                                           
*-------*                                                           
                                                                    
     EXEC SQL                                                       
         DECLARE CSR1000 CURSOR FOR                                 
         SELECT FLIGHTDATE, DEPTIME, ARRTIME, TOTPASS,              
                FLIGHTNUM, AIRPORTDEP, AIRPORTARR                   
         FROM FLIGHT                                                
         WHERE FLIGHTDATE = :FDATEI AND AIRPORTARR = :LAIRI         
         FOR FETCH ONLY                                             
     END-EXEC                                                       
                                                                    
*-------*                                                           
*CSR1100*                                                           
*-------*                                                           
                                                                    
     EXEC SQL                                                       
         DECLARE CSR1100 CURSOR FOR                                 
         SELECT FLIGHTDATE, DEPTIME, ARRTIME, TOTPASS,              
                FLIGHTNUM, AIRPORTDEP, AIRPORTARR

     END-EXEC                                                       
                                                                    
****************************************************************    
*                   TABLE CICS WS DECLARATION.                 *    
****************************************************************

 01  WS-TABLE. 
     02 WS-FLYDT                     PIC X(10). 
     02 WS-FLYTD                     PIC X(8). 
     02 WS-FLYTL                     PIC X(8). 
     02 WS-FLYPL                     PIC S9(9) USAGE COMP. 
     02 WS-FLYNUM                    PIC X(6). 
     02 WS-FLYDE                     PIC X(4). 
     02 WS-FLYLD                     PIC X(4). 
                                                              
 01  WS-CURRENT-DATE. 
     02 WS-DATE. 
        03 WS-YEAR                      PIC 9(4). 
        03 WS-MONTH                     PIC 9(2). 
        03 WS-DAY                       PIC 9(2). 
     02 WS-TIME. 
        03 WS-HOUR                      PIC 9(2). 
        03 WS-MINUTE                    PIC 9(2). 
        03 WS-SECOND                    PIC 9(2).

     02 YEAR                            PIC 9(4). 
     02 DASH1                           PIC X. 
     02 MONTH                           PIC 9(2). 
     02 DASH2                           PIC X. 
     02 DAYS                            PIC 9(2).

     02 2-DAYS                          PIC 9(2). 
     02 2-DASH1                         PIC X. 
     02 2-MONTH                         PIC 9(2). 
     02 2-DASH2                         PIC X. 
     02 2-YEAR                          PIC 9(4).

     02 H-HOUR                          PIC 9(2). 
     02 H-DASH1                           PIC X. 
     02 H-MIN                           PIC 9(2). 
     02 H-DASH2                           PIC X. 
     02 H-SEC                           PIC 9(2). 
                                                                 
*****************************************************************

*****************************************************************
                                                                 
 01  COUNT1                             PIC 9(4) VALUE ZEROS. 
 01  COUNT2                             PIC 9(2). 
 01  COUNT3                             PIC 9(2). 
                                                                 
*----------------* 
 LINKAGE SECTION. 
*----------------* 
                                                                 
 01  DFHCOMMAREA. 
     02 TRANSACTION     PIC X(4). 
     02 USER-ID         PIC X(8). 
                                                                 
*****************************************************************
*                      PROCEDURE DIVISION                       *
***************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 PROCEDURE DIVISION. 
                                                                  
***************************************************************** 
* MAIN-PARA.                                                    * 
*                                                               * 
* THIS PROGRAM WORKS WITH A PSEUDO-CONVERSATION METHOD.         * 
* THE MAIN PARAGRAPH SET THE PROCEDURE FLOW WHICH CONTROLS THE  * 
* SRCHLI MAP.                                                   * 
***************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 MAIN-PARA. 
                                                                  
     IF EIBCALEN = 0 
         MOVE 'INSERT THE DATA TO DO A RESEARCH' TO MSG1O 
         PERFORM 0100-GET-DFHCOMMAREA 
         PERFORM 0200-GET-TIME 
         PERFORM 0210-GIVING-TIME 
         PERFORM 0300-SEND-MAP 
         PERFORM 0400-RETURN-CICS 
     ELSE 
         MOVE SPACE TO MSG1O 
         MOVE SPACE TO MSG2O 
         PERFORM 0410-MOVE-SPACE 
         PERFORM 0500-RECEIVE-MAP 
         PERFORM 0100-GET-DFHCOMMAREA 
         PERFORM 0510-VERIFY-EIBAID 
         PERFORM 0600-PROCESS-RESEARCH 
         PERFORM 0200-GET-TIME 
         PERFORM 0210-GIVING-TIME 
         PERFORM 0300-SEND-MAP 
         PERFORM 0400-RETURN-CICS 
     END-IF. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0100-GET-DFHCOMMAREA                                        *      
*                                                             *      
* MOVE USER-ID FROM DFHCOMMAREA TO WS-USERID.                 *      
***************************************************************      
                                                                     
 0100-GET-DFHCOMMAREA.                                               
                                                                     
     MOVE USER-ID TO WS-USER-ID                                      
     MOVE EIBTRMID TO WS-TERMINAL.                                   
                                                                     
***************************************************************      
* 0200-GET-TIME.                                              *      
*                                                             *      
* FOR GET THE TIME WE CAN UTILISE THE CICS METHOD OR THE COBOL*      
* METHOD IF THE FUNCTION CURRENT-TIME. BUT HERE WE CHOSE THE  *      
* THE CICS METHOD.                                            *      
***************************************************************      
                                                                     
 0200-GET-TIME.                                                      
                                                                     
     MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE(1:14) TO WS-CURRENT-DATE.            
     MOVE WS-YEAR TO 2-YEAR                                          
     MOVE WS-MONTH TO 2-MONTH                                        
     MOVE WS-DAY TO 2-DAYS                                           
     MOVE '/' TO 2-DASH1                                             
     MOVE '/' TO 2-DASH2                                             
                                                                     
     MOVE WS-YEAR TO YEAR                                            
     MOVE WS-MONTH TO MONTH                                          
     MOVE WS-DAY TO DAYS                                             
     MOVE '-' TO DASH1                                               
     MOVE '-' TO DASH2                                               
                                                                     
     MOVE WS-HOUR TO H-HOUR                                          
     MOVE WS-MINUTE TO H-MIN                                         
     MOVE WS-SECOND TO H-SEC                                         
     MOVE ':' TO H-DASH1 
     MOVE ':' TO H-DASH2. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0210-GIVING-TIME.                                           * 
*                                                             * 
* AFTER GETTING THE TIME ITS NECESSARY TO TRANSFER THIS INFO  * 
* TO THE LOGIN MAP ITSELF                                     * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0210-GIVING-TIME. 
                                                                  
     MOVE WS-EDIT-HOUR TO LHOURO 
     MOVE WS-EDIT-DATE2 TO LDATEO. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0300-SEND-MAP.                                              * 
*                                                             * 
* SEND MAP PROCEDURE IS IMPORTANTE TO CHANGE INFORMATIONS WITH* 
* THE USER AND IN THE PSEUDO CONVERSATION METHOD.             * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0300-SEND-MAP. 
                                                                  
     MOVE WS-USERID TO USERIDO 
     MOVE WS-TERINAL TO TERMO 
                                                                  
     EXEC CICS 
         SEND MAP('SRCHPA')  MAPSET('SRCHFLI') ERASE 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0400-RETURN-CICS.                                           * 
*                                                             * 
* RETURN LETS THE PROGRAM FREE TO RECEIVE OTHER INFORMATIONS  * 
* FROM ANOTHER USERS.                                         * 
* THE COMMUNICATION-AREA IS USED TO SEND INFORMATION BETWEEN  * 
* MAPS.                                                       * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0400-RETURN-CICS. 
                                                                  
     MOVE WS-USERID TO USER-ID 
                                                                  
     EXEC CICS 
         RETURN TRANSID ('SCHF') 
         COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA) 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0410-MOVE-SPACE                                             * 
*                                                             * 
* IT MOVE SPACE TO THE MAP'S VARIABLES. IT IS IMPORTANTE TO   * 
* VERIFY IF ANY INFORMATION WAS INSERT IN IT.                 * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0410-MOVE-SPACE.
