     MOVE SPACE TO DAIRI 
     MOVE SPACE TO LAIRI. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0500-RECEIVE-MAP.                                           * 
*                                                             * 
* IT RECEIVES THE USER INFORMATION TO BE PROCESSED            * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0500-RECEIVE-MAP. 
                                                                  
     EXEC CICS 
         RECEIVE MAP('SRCHPA')  MAPSET('SRCHFLI') 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                
*************************************************************** 
* 0510-VERIFY-EIBAID                                          * 
*                                                             * 
* IT CHECKS IF THE USER PRESS ANY FKEY WHICH IS REALATED WITH * 
* ANOTHER MAP OR FUNCTION.                                    * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                
 0510-VERIFY-EIBAID. 
                                                                
     EVALUATE EIBAID 
        WHEN DFHPF3 
                                                                
            EXEC CICS XCTL 
               PROGRAM('LOGIN') 
               COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA) 
               LENGTH(12) 
            END-EXEC 
                                                                
        WHEN DFHPF4 
                                                                
            MOVE 'THIS IS THE CURRENT MAP' TO MSG1O 
                                                                
        WHEN DFHPF5 
                                                                
            EXEC CICS XCTL 
               PROGRAM('SRCHTKT') 
               COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA) 
               LENGTH(12) 
            END-EXEC 
                                                                
        WHEN DFHPF6 
                                                                
            EXEC CICS XCTL 
                PROGRAM('SELLCOB1') 
                COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)
                LENGTH(12) 
            END-EXEC 
                                                                
        WHEN DFHPF7 
                                                                 
            MOVE 'THIS MAP IS NOT READY YET' TO MSG1O 
                                                                 
     END-EVALUATE. 
                                                                 
*************************************************************** 
* 0600-PROCESS-RESEARCH                                       * 
*                                                             * 
* THE PROGRAM WILL ANALYZE WHICH INFORMATION THE USER PROVIDES* 
* AND WILL UTILISE THE CORRESPONDING CURSOR                   * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                 
 0600-PROCESS-RESEARCH. 
                                                                 
     PERFORM 0610-GET-INFORMATION 
     PERFORM 0620-SELECT-DB2INFO. 
                                                                 
*****************************************************************
* 0610-GET-INFORMATION.                                         *
*                                                               *
* IT GETS THE INFORMATION FROM THE USER FROM CICS               *
*****************************************************************
                                                                 
 0610-GET-INFORMATION. 
                                                                 
     MOVE ZEROS TO COUNT1 
                                                                 
     IF FNUMI NOT = SPACE 
        ADD 1 TO COUNT1 
     END-IF 
                                                                 
     IF FDATEI NOT = SPACE AND FDATEI NOT = 'YYYY-MM-DD' 
        ADD 10 TO COUNT1 
     END-IF 
                                                                 
     IF DAIRI(2:1) NOT = SPACE AND COUNT1(4:1) = ZERO 
        ADD 100 TO COUNT1 
     END-IF 
                                                                  
     IF LAIRI (2:1) NOT = SPACE AND COUNT1(4:1) = ZERO 
        ADD 1000 TO COUNT1 
     END-IF. 
                                                                  
***************************************************************** 
* 0620-SELECT-DB2INFO.                                          * 
*                                                               * 
* IT GETS THE DB2 DATA ACCORDING THE INFO INSERT BY USER        * 
* 1 = FLIGHTNUM                                                 * 
* 10 = DATE                                                     * 
* 11 = DATE AND FLIGHNUM                                        * 
* 100 = DEPARTURE AIRPORT                                       * 
* 110 = DEPARTURE AIRPORT AND DATE                              * 
* 1000 = ARRIVAL AIRPORT                                        * 
* 1010 = AARRIVAL AIRPORT AND DATE                              * 
* 1100 = DEPARTURE AIRPORT AND ARRIVAL AIRPORT                  * 
* 1110 = DEPARTURE AIRPORT AND ARRIVAL AIRPORT AND DATE         * 
***************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0620-SELECT-DB2INFO. 
                                                                  
     EVALUATE COUNT1 
                                                                  
        WHEN 1 
            PERFORM 0621-SQL-FNUM 
                                                                  
        WHEN 10 
            PERFORM 0800-VERIFY-DATE 
            PERFORM 0622-SQL-FDATE 
                                                                  
        WHEN 11 
            PERFORM 0623-SQL-FNUM-FDATE 
                                                                     
        WHEN 100                                                     
            MOVE WS-EDIT-DATE TO FDATE                               
            PERFORM 0624 SQL-DAIR                                    
                                                                     
        WHEN 110                                                     
            PERFORM 0800-VERIFY-DATE                                 
            PERFORM 0624-SQL-DAIR                                    
                                                                     
        WHEN 1000                                                    
            MOVE WS-EDIT-DATE TO FDATE                               
            PERFORM 0625-SQL-LAIR                                    
                                                                     
        WHEN 1010                                                    
            PERFORM 0800-VERIFY-DATE                                 
            PERFORM 0625-SQL-LAIR                                    
                                                                     
        WHEN 1100                                                    
            MOVE WS-EDIT-DATE TO FDATE                               
            PERFORM 0626-SQL-LAIR-DAIR                               
                                                                     
        WHEN 1110                                                    
            PERFORM 0800-VERIFY-DATE                                 
            PERFORM 0626-SQL-LAIR-DAIR                               
                                                                     
        WHEN 0                                                       
            MOVE 'NO DATA INSERT, TRY AGAIN' TO MSG1O

     EXEC SQL 
         OPEN CSR1 
     END-EXEC 
                                                                  
*****************************************************************

                 :WS-FLYNUM, :WS-FLYDE, :WS-FLYLD 
        END-EXEC 
                                                                  
        EVALUATE SQLCODE 
          WHEN 0

          WHEN 100 
             CONTINUE 
          WHEN OTHER

     END-PERFORM 
                                                                  
     MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAG-DATE

 0624-SQL-DAIR.

 0625-SQL-LAIR.

               MOVE WS-FLYDT TO FLIDT0O

               MOVE WS-FLYTD TO FLITD1O 
               MOVE WS-FLYTL TO FLITL1O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDE TO FLIDE1O 
               MOVE WS-FLYLD TO FLILD1O 
               MOVE WS-FLYPL TO FLIPL1O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDT TO FLIDT1O 
                                                                  
           WHEN 3

               MOVE WS-FLYTD TO FLITD2O 
               MOVE WS-FLYTL TO FLITL2O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDE TO FLIDE2O 
               MOVE WS-FLYLD TO FLILD2O 
               MOVE WS-FLYPL TO FLIPL2O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDT TO FLIDT2O 
                                                                
           WHEN 4 
                                                                
               MOVE WS-FLYNUM TO FLIID3O 
               MOVE WS-FLYTD TO FLITD3O 
               MOVE WS-FLYTL TO FLITL3O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDE TO FLIDE3O

               MOVE WS-FLYDE TO FLIDE4O

               MOVE WS-FLYDT TO FLIDT4O

               MOVE WS-FLYTD TO FLITD5O 
               MOVE WS-FLYTL TO FLITL5O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDE TO FLIDE5O 
               MOVE WS-FLYLD TO FLILD5O 
               MOVE WS-FLYPL TO FLIPL5O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDT TO FLIDT5O 
                                                               
           WHEN 7 
                                                               
               MOVE WS-FLYNUM TO FLIID6O 
               MOVE WS-FLYTD TO FLITD6O 
               MOVE WS-FLYTL TO FLITL6O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDE TO FLIDE6O 
               MOVE WS-FLYLD TO FLILD6O 
               MOVE WS-FLYPL TO FLIPL6O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDT TO FLIDT6O 
                                                               
           WHEN 8 
                                                               
               MOVE WS-FLYNUM TO FLIID7O 
               MOVE WS-FLYTD TO FLITD7O 
               MOVE WS-FLYTL TO FLITL7O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDE TO FLIDE7O 
               MOVE WS-FLYLD TO FLILD7O 
               MOVE WS-FLYPL TO FLIPL7O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDT TO FLIDT7O 
                                                               
           WHEN 9

               MOVE WS-FLYTD TO FLITD8O 
               MOVE WS-FLYTL TO FLITL8O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDE TO FLIDE8O 
               MOVE WS-FLYLD TO FLILD8O 
               MOVE WS-FLYPL TO FLIPL8O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDT TO FLIDT8O 
                                                               
           WHEN 10 
                                                               
               MOVE WS-FLYNUM TO FLIID9O 
               MOVE WS-FLYTD TO FLITD9O 
               MOVE WS-FLYTL TO FLITL9O 
               MOVE WS-FLYDE TO FLIDE9O                              
               MOVE WS-FLYLD TO FLILD9O                              
               MOVE WS-FLYPL TO FLIPL9O                              
               MOVE WS-FLYDT TO FLIDT9O.                             
                                                                     
****************************************************************     
* 0700-SQL-ERROR.                                              *     
*                                                              *     
* IT SENDS THE SQLCODE AND SQLSTATE TO THE USER, IF IT OCCURS  *     
****************************************************************     
                                                                     
 0700-SQL-ERROR.                                                     
                                                                     
     MOVE 'DB2 ERROR, CALL THE IT DEPARTMENT' TO MSG1O               
     MOVE 'INFROM THE ERROR: ' TO MSG2O                              
     MOVE SQLCODE TO MSG2O(20:10)                                    
     MOVE 'AND' TO MSG2O(31:3)                                       
     MOVE SQLSTATE TO MSG2O (35:10).                                 
                                                                     
****************************************************************     
* 0800-VERIFY-DATE.                                            *     
*                                                              *     
* TO MINIMIZE THE ERRORS, THIS PARAGRAPH VERIFY THE DATE FORMAT*     
* IF IT'S NOT ACCORDING WITH THE DB2 EXIGENCY THE PROGRAM SEND *     
* A MESSAGE TO THE USER AND DOES NOT ALLOW A SQL ERROR         *     
****************************************************************     
                                                                     
 0800-VERIFY-DATE.                                                   
                                                                     
     IF FDATEI(1:4) NOT NUMERIC OF FDATEI(6:2) NOT NUMERIC OR        
                                   FDATEI(9:2) NOT NUMERIC           
        MOVE 'N' TO WS-FLAG-DATE                                     
     ELSE                                                            
     IF FDATEI(5:1) NOT = '-' OR FDATEI(7:1) NOT = '-'               
        MOVE 'N' TO WS-FLAG-DATE                                     
     END-IF                                                          
                                                                  
     MOVE 'WRONG DATE FORMAT, TRY TO INSERT DATE AS YYYY-MM-DD' TO
                                                MSG1O.

*CSR1* 
*----* 
                                                                  
     EXEC SQL 
         DECLARE CSR1 CURSOR FOR

                C.FLIGHTDATE, C.DEPTIME, C.ARRTIME, C.FLIGHTNUM, 
                C.AIRPORTDEP, C.AIRPORTARR

         JOIN PASSENGERS AS B ON B.CLIENTID = A.CLIENTID 
         JOIN FLIGHT AS C ON C.FLIGHTID = A.FLIGHTID

***************************************************************     
* 0511-CALL-INTRDR                                            *     
*                                                             *     
* THIS PARAGRAPH WILL SEND A AUTO-EXEC JCL TO PRINT A DOCUMENT*     
* TO WORK IT WILL NEED TO CHANGE THE MSGCLASS OF THE JOB TO   *     
* A CORRENSPONDING MSGCLASS PRINT DEFINED BY THE ADMINISTRATOR*     
***************************************************************     
                                                                    
 0511-CALL-INTRDR.                                                  
                                                                    
     MOVE 1 TO WS-COUNT4.                                           
                                                                    
     EXEC CICS SPOOLOPEN OUTPUT                                     
         TOKEN (WS-TOKEN)                                           
         USERID (WS-USERID)                                         
         NODE (WS-NODE)                                             
         CLASS (WS-CLASS)                                           
         RESP  (WS-RESP)                                            
         RESP2 (WS-RESP2)                                           
     END-EXEC                                                       
                                                                    
     IF WS-RESP = 0 AND WS-RESP2 = 0                                
                                                                    
        PERFORM VARYING COUNT3 FROM 1 BY 1  UNTIL COUNT3 > 30 OR    
                                      JCL-JOB(COUNT4:3) = '//*'     
                                                                    
           IF JCL-JOB(COUNT4:80) NOT = SPACE                        
              MOVE JCL-JOB (COUNT4:80) TO WS-CICSOUT                
           ELSE                                                       
              PERFORM 0512-MOVE-VARIABLES                             
              MOVE JCL-JOB (COUNT4:80) TO WS-CICSOUT                  
           END-IF                                                     
                                                                      
           EXEC CICS SPOOLWRITE                                       
               TOKEN (WS-TOKEN)                                       
               FROM (WS-CICSOUT)                                      
               RESP  (WS-RESP)                                        
               RESP2 (WS-RESP2)                                       
           END-EXEC                                                   
                                                                      
           IF WS-RESP NOT = 0 OR WS-RESP2 NOT = 0                     
               MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAGCICS                                
           END-IF                                                     
                                                                      
           ADD 80 TO COUNT4                                           
                                                                      
        END-PERFORM                                                   
                                                                      
     ELSE                                                             
        MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAGCICS                                       
     END-IF                                                           
                                                                      
     EXEC CICS SPOOLCLOSE                                             
         TOKEN (WS-TOKEN)                                             
         RESP  (WS-RESP)                                              
         RESP2 (WS-RESP2)                                             
     END-EXEC                                                         
                                                                      
     IF WS-FLAGCICS = 'N'                                             
        MOVE 'TICKET SUCCESSFULLY PRINTED'                            
     ELSE                                                             
        MOVE 'ERROR IN THE PRINT PROCESS'                             
     END-IF.

* 0625-DB2-CSR100.                                            *     
*                                                             *     
* THIS COURSOR WILL SEARCH THE TICKETS INFORMATION BY THE     *     
* FIRST NAME AND LAST NAME.                                   *     
***************************************************************     
                                                                    
 0625-DB2-CSR100.                                                   
                                                                    
     EXEC SQL                                                       
         OPEN CSR100                                                
     END-EXEC                                                       
                                                                    
     PERFORM VARYING COUNT2 FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL COUNT2 > 10 OR        
                         WS-FLAG-DATE = 'N' OR WS-FLAGSQL = 'N'     
        EXEC SQL                                                    
            FETCH CSR100                                            
            INTO :T-TICKETID, :T-SEATNUM, :PA-FIRSTNAME_TEXT,       
                 :PA-LASTNAME_TEXT, :FLIGHTDATE, :DEPTIME,          
                 :ARRTIME, :FLIGHTNUM, :AIRPORTDEP, :AIRPORTARR     
        END-EXEC                                                    
                                                                    
        PERFORM 0630-VERIFY-SQLCODE 
                                                                  
        MOVE COUNT2 TO WS-TPAGE 
                                                                  
     END-PERFORM 
                                                                  
     EXEC SQL 
         CLOSE CSR100 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0626-DB2-CSR101.                                            * 
*                                                             * 
* THIS COURSOR WILL SEARCH THE TICKETS INFORMATION BY THE     * 
* FIRST NAME AND LAST NAME AND FLIGHT NUMBER                  * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0626-DB2-CSR101. 
                                                                  
     EXEC SQL 
         OPEN CSR101 
     END-EXEC 
                                                                  
     PERFORM VARYING COUNT2 FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL COUNT2 > 10 OR 
                         WS-FLAG-DATE = 'N' OR WS-FLAGSQL = 'N' 
        EXEC SQL 
            FETCH CSR101 
            INTO :T-TICKETID, :T-SEATNUM, :PA-FIRSTNAME_TEXT, 
                 :PA-LASTNAME_TEXT, :FLIGHTDATE, :DEPTIME, 
                 :ARRTIME, :FLIGHTNUM, :AIRPORTDEP, :AIRPORTARR

        PERFORM 0630-VERIFY-SQLCODE

     END-PERFORM                                                     
                                                                     
     EXEC SQL                                                        
         CLOSE CSR101                                                
     END-EXEC.                                                       
                                                                     
***************************************************************      
* 0627-DB2-CSR102.                                            *      
*                                                             *      
* THIS COURSOR WILL SEARCH THE TICKETS INFORMATION BY THE     *      
* FIRST NAME AND LAST NAME AND DATE.                          *      
***************************************************************      
                                                                     
 0627-DB2-CSR102.                                                    
                                                                     
     EXEC SQL                                                        
         OPEN CSR102                                                 
     END-EXEC                                                        
                                                                     
     PERFORM VARYING COUNT2 FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL COUNT2 > 10 OR         
                         WS-FLAG-DATE = 'N' OR WS-FLAGSQL = 'N'      
        EXEC SQL                                                     
            FETCH CSR102                                             
            INTO :T-TICKETID, :T-SEATNUM, :PA-FIRSTNAME_TEXT,        
                 :PA-LASTNAME_TEXT, :FLIGHTDATE, :DEPTIME,           
                 :ARRTIME, :FLIGHTNUM, :AIRPORTDEP, :AIRPORTARR      
        END-EXEC                                                     
                                                                     
        PERFORM 0630-VERIFY-SQLCODE                                  
                                                                     
        MOVE COUNT2 TO WS-TPAGE                                      
                                                                     
     END-PERFORM                                                     
                                                                     
     EXEC SQL                                                        
         CLOSE CSR102                                                
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0628-INCORRECT.                                             * 
*                                                             * 
* IT RETOURN THE PARAMETERS WHICH RETURN A VALID RESEARCH IF  * 
* THE USER INSERT A INVALID COMBINATION OF DATAS.             * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0628-INCORRECT. 
                                                                  
     MOVE  'A VALIDE RESEARCHS MUST HAVE AT LEAST: TICKTID' TO 
                           MSG1O 
     MOVE  "OR CLIENTID OR CLIENT'S FIRST AND LAST NAME" TO MSG2O.
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
* 0629-MOVE-DATA                                               * 
*                                                              * 
* IT MOVE THE FIND DATA TO A TABLE TO BECOME POSSIBLE THE PAGE * 
* FUNCTION IN THE MAP. SO WHEN THE USER CHANGE THE PAGE THE    * 
* CORRESPONDING INFORMATION WILL FIND BY THE MATCH BETWEEN PAGE* 
* AND COUNT2                                                   * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0629-MOVE-DATA. 
                                                                  
     MOVE T-TICKETID TO WS-TICKETID(COUNT2) 
     MOVE T-SEATNUM TO WS-SEATNUM(COUNT2) 
     MOVE PA-FIRSTNAME_TEXT TO WS-FIRSTNAME(COUNT2) 
     MOVE PA-LASTNAME_TEXT TO WS-LASTNAME(COUNT2) 
     MOVE FLIGHTDATE TO WS-FDATE(COUNT2) 
     MOVE DEPTIME TO WS-DEPTIME(COUNT2) 
     MOVE ARRTIME TO WS-ARRTIME(COUNT2) 
     MOVE FLIGHTNUM TO WS-FLIGHTNUM(COUNT2) 
     MOVE AIRPORTDEP TO WS-AIRPORTDEP(COUNT2) 
     MOVE AIRPORTARR TO WS-AIRPORTARR(COUNT2) 
                                                                    
***************************************************************     
* 0630-VERIFY-SQLCODE                                         *     
*                                                             *     
* IT WILL VERIFY IF THE RESEARCH RETURN A VALIDE DATA (SQLCODE*     
* =0) OR IF THE TABLE REACH THE END (SQLCODE=100) OR IF THERE *     
* IS A PROBLEM IN THE RESEARCH (OTHER SQLCODE).               *     
***************************************************************     
                                                                    
 0630-VERIFY-SQLCODE.                                               
                                                                    
        EVALUATE SQLCODE                                            
           WHEN 0                                                   
               PERFORM 0629-MOVE-DATA                               
           WHEN 100                                                 
               IF COUNT2 = 1                                        
                 MOVE 'NO DATA MATCH WITH THIS INSERT INFORMATION'  
                            TO MSG1O                                
               ELSE                                                 
                 MOVE 1 TO WS-F11                                   
                 SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-TOTPAGE                         
               END-IF                                               
                                                                    
               MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAGSQL                               
                                                                    
           WHEN OTHER                                               
               MOVE 'COMMUNICATION ERROR BETWEEN SYSTEM AND DB, CA  
-                'LL IT DEPT'  TO MSG1O                             
              MOVE 'INFORM THE FOLLOW ERROR CODE: ' TO MSG2O        
              MOVE SQLCODE TO MSG2O(31:10)                          
              MOVE 'AND' TO MSG2O(42:3)                             
              MOVE  SQLSTATE TO MSG2O (46:10)                       
        END-EVALUATE.                                               
                                                                    
****************************************************************    
* 0640-VERIFY-DATE.                                            *    
*                                                              * 
* TO MINIMIZE THE ERRORS, THIS PARAGRAPH VERIFY THE DATE FORMAT* 
* IF IT'S NOT ACCORDING WITH THE DB2 EXIGENCY THE PROGRAM SEND * 
* A MESSAGE TO THE USER AND DOES NOT ALLOW A SQL ERROR         * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0640-VERIFY-DATE. 
                                                                  
     IF FDATEI(1:4) NOT NUMERIC OF FDATEI(6:2) NOT NUMERIC OR 
                                   FDATEI(9:2) NOT NUMERIC 
        MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAG-DATE 
     ELSE 
     IF FDATEI(5:1) NOT = '-' OR FDATEI(7:1) NOT = '-' 
        MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAG-DATE 
     END-IF 
                                                                  
     MOVE 'WRONG DATE FORMAT, TRY TO INSERT DATE AS YYYY-MM-DD' TO
                                                MSG1O. 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
* 0700-GET-CORRECT-INFO                                        * 
*                                                              * 
* THIS PARAGRAPH GETS THE CORRECT INFORMATION IN ACCORD WITH   * 
* THE PAGE REQUESTED.                                          * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0700-GET-CORRECT-INFO. 
                                                                  
     MOVE WS-F11 TO FPAGEO(1:2) 
     MOVE '/' TO FPAGEO(3:1) 
     MOVE WS-TPAGE TO FPAGEO(4:2) 
     MOVE WS-TICKETID(WS-F11) TO STKTIDO

     MOVE WS-DEPTIME(WS-F11) TO STDEPO 
     MOVE WS-ARRTIME(WS-F11) TO STLANO 
     MOVE WS-FLIGHTNUM(WS-F11) TO SFLIIDO 
     MOVE WS-AIRPORTDEP(WS-F11) TO SDAIRO 
     MOVE WS-AIRPORTARR(WS-F11) TO SLAIRO

******************************************************************    
* PROGRAM NAME                 : CRYPTPGM                        *    
* IMPORTANT FILE               : PASSDOC                         *    
* PROGRAMMER                   : KERESTES                        *    
* DATE OF WRITEN               : SEPT. 2022                      *    
* TECHNOLOGY                   : CICS + COBOL + DB2              *    
******************************************************************    
*                   PROBLEM  DEFINITION                          *    
*                                                                *    
* THIS PROGRAM MAKE THE PASSWORD ENCRYPTATION                    *    
******************************************************************    
* INPUT PARAMETERS:                                              *    
*                                                                *    
* PASSWORD, CLIENTID, ADMINDATE                                  *    
******************************************************************    
* OUTPUT PARAMETERS:                                             *    
*                                                                *    
* ENCRYPTED PASSWORD                                             *    
******************************************************************    
                                                                      
******************************************************************    
*                  IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                      *    
******************************************************************    
                                                                      
 IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                                             
 PROGRAM-ID. CRYPTPGM.                                                
                                                                      
******************************************************************    
*                  ENVIRONMENT    DIVISION.                      *    
******************************************************************    
                                                                      
 ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.                                                
                                                                      
*---------------------*                                               
 INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.                                                
 *---------------------*                                             
                                                                    
 FILE-CONTROL.                                                      
                                                                    
     SELECT PASSFILE ASSIGN TO PASSDOC                              
     ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL                                     
     FILE STATUS IS FS-PASSFILE.                                    
                                                                    
******************************************************************  
*                          DATA   DIVISION.                      *  
******************************************************************  
                                                                    
 DATA DIVISION.                                                     
                                                                    
*-------------*                                                     
 FILE SECTION.                                                      
*-------------*                                                     
                                                                    
 FD PASSFILE.                                                       
                                                                    
 01 TOTFILE.                                                        
     02  FILE-USERID    PIC X(8).                                   
     02  FILE-PASS      PIC X(8).                                   
     02  FILLER         PIC X(4).                                   
                                                                    
*------------------------*                                          
 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.                                           
*------------------------*                                          
                                                                    
 01  FS-PASSFILE                      PIC X(2).                     
     88  FS-PASSFILE-OK               VALUE '00'.                   
                                                                    
 01  PASSFILE-KEY                     PIC 9(9) VALUE 0.             
                                                                    
 01  WS-DATE             PIC 9(8).                                  
                                                                    
 01  WS-USERID1          PIC 9(4) COMP.                             
 01  WS-USERID REDEFINES WS-USERID1 PIC X(2).                       
                                                                    
 01  WS-PASS             PIC 9(4) COMP.                             
 01  WS-PASSWORD REDEFINES WS-PASS PIC X(2).                        
                                                                    
 01  WS-KEY1             PIC 9(4) COMP.                             
 01  WS-KEY REDEFINES WS-KEY1 PIC 9(2).                             
                                                                    
 01  WS-COUNTER1         PIC 9(2).                                  
 01  WS-COUNTER2         PIC 9(2).                                  
                                                                    
 01  WS-MOD1             PIC 9.                                     
                                                                    
 01  WS-CRYPTPASS.                                                  
     02  WS-CRYPTCHAR    PIC X OCCURS 8 TIMES.                      
                                                                    
*----------------*                                                  
 LINKAGE SECTION.                                                   
*----------------*                                                  
                                                                    
 01  LS-PASSWORD         PIC X(8).                                  
 01  LS-USERID           PIC X(8).                                  
 01  LS-ADDATE           PIC X(10).                                 
                                                                    
*****************************************************************   
*             PROCEDURE DIVISION WITH LINKAGE SECTION           *   
*****************************************************************   
                                                                    
 PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LS-PASSWORD, LS-USERID, LS-ADDATE.        
                                                                    
 MAIN-PARA.                                                         
                                                                    
     PERFORM 0100-OPEN-FILE.                                        
     PERFORM 0200-CRYPTPASS.                                        
     PERFORM 0300-WRITE-FILE.                                       
     PERFORM 0400-CLOSE-FILE. 
                                                                  
     GOBACK. 
                                                                  
***************************************************************** 
* 0100-OPEN-FILE.                                               * 
*                                                               * 
* IT OPENS THE FILE TO PUT THE ENCRYPTED PASSWORD.              * 
***************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0100-OPEN-FILE. 
                                                                  
                                                                  
     OPEN EXTEND PASSFILE 
                                                                  
     IF NOT FS-PASSFILE-OK 
         DISPLAY 'ERROR TO ACCES THE PASSWORD STORAGE' 
         DISPLAY 'THE PROGRAM WILL BE END' 
         DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' FS-PASSFILE 
         STOP RUN 
     END-IF. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0200-CRYPTPASS.                                             * 
*                                                             * 
* IT MAKES THE ENCRYPTATION.                                  * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0200-CRYPTPASS. 
                                                                  
     MOVE LS-USERID(6:3) TO PASSFILE-KEY 
     ADD 1 TO PASSFILE-KEY 
     MOVE LS-ADDATE(7:4) TO WS-DATE(1:4) 
     MOVE LS-ADDATE(4:2) TO WS-DATE(7:2) 
     MOVE LS-ADDATE (1:2) TO WS-DATE(5:2) 
     DISPLAY WS-DATE 
                                                                      
     INITIALIZE WS-CRYPTPASS.                                         
                                                                      
     COMPUTE WS-KEY = FUNCTION RANDOM (WS-DATE) * 1000                
                                                                      
     MOVE LS-USERID(1:4) TO WS-USERID                                 
                                                                      
     PERFORM WITH TEST BEFORE VARYING WS-COUNTER1 FROM 1 BY 1         
                        UNTIL WS-COUNTER1 > 8 OR                      
                        LS-PASSWORD(WS-COUNTER1:1) = SPACE            
                                                                      
         PERFORM WITH TEST AFTER VARYING WS-COUNTER2 FROM             
                               WS-COUNTER1 BY 1 UNTIL                 
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'40'  AND         
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'10'  AND         
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'00'  AND         
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'30'  AND         
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'20'              
                                                                      
         COMPUTE WS-MOD1 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-COUNTER2 3)                
                                                                      
         MOVE LS-PASSWORD(WS-COUNTER1:2) TO WS-PASSWORD               
         MOVE LS-USERID(WS-COUNTER1:2) TO WS-USERID                   
                                                                      
         EVALUATE WS-MOD1                                             
            WHEN 0                                                    
                COMPUTE WS-KEY1 = WS-PASS * WS-KEY1                   
                                                                      
                MOVE WS-KEY1 TO WS-PASS                               
                MOVE WS-PASSWORD(2:1) TO WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1)    
                                                                      
            WHEN 1                                                    
                COMPUTE WS-USERID1 = WS-PASS * WS-USERID1             
                                                                      
                MOVE WS-USERID(2:1) TO WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1)      
                                                                      
            WHEN 2                                                   
             COMPUTE  WS-KEY1 = WS-PASS * WS-USERID1 * WS-KEY1       
                                                                     
                MOVE WS-KEY1 TO WS-PASS                              
                MOVE WS-PASSWORD(2:1) TO WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1)   
                                                                     
         END-EVALUATE                                                
                                                                     
         END-PERFORM                                                 
                                                                     
     END-PERFORM.                                                    
                                                                     
*****************************************************************    
* 0300-WRITE-FILE.                                              *    
*                                                               *    
* IT WRITES THE USERID AND THE ENCRYPTED PASSWORD IN A PS FILE  *    
*****************************************************************    
                                                                     
 0300-WRITE-FILE.                                                    
                                                                     
     MOVE WS-CRYPTPASS TO FILE-PASS                                  
     MOVE LS-USERID TO FILE-USERID                                   
                                                                     
     WRITE TOTFILE                                                   
          INVALID KEY DISPLAY 'THIS IS NOT A VALID USERID'           
          DISPLAY 'THE USER INFORMATIONS WILL NOT BE REGISTRED'      
          DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' FS-PASSFILE                              
     END-WRITE                                                       
                                                                     
     IF NOT FS-PASSFILE-OK                                           
        DISPLAY 'ERROR TO WRITE: ' FS-PASSFILE                       
     END-IF.                                                         
                                                                     
***************************************************************      
* 0400-CLOSE-FILE                                             *      
*                                                             *      
* IT CLOSES THE PS FILE                                       *
***************************************************************
                                                               
 0400-CLOSE-FILE. 
                                                               
     CLOSE PASSFILE 
                                                               
     IF NOT FS-PASSFILE-OK 
        DISPLAY 'THERE IS A PROBLEM TO CLOSE THE STORAGE' 
        DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' FS-PASSFILE 
     END-IF.

 IDENTIFICATION                            DIVISION.                   
 PROGRAM-ID. SUINSRT.

******************************************************************     
                                                                       
 ENVIRONMENT                               DIVISION.                   
                                                                       
*---------------------*                                                
 INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.                                               
*---------------------*                                              
                                                                     
 FILE-CONTROL.                                                       
                                                                     
     SELECT INSERTEMP ASSIGN TO EMPLIST                              
     ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL                                      
     FILE STATUS IS FS-INSERTEMP.                                    
                                                                     
******************************************************************   
*                        DATA DIVISION.                          *   
******************************************************************   
                                                                     
 DATA                                      DIVISION.                 
                                                                     
*-------------*                                                      
 FILE SECTION.                                                       
*-------------*                                                      
                                                                     
 FD INSERTEMP RECORDING MODE IS F.                                   
                                                                     
 01  IN-JSON                          PIC X(13000).                  
                                                                     
*------------------------*                                           
 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.                                            
*------------------------*                                           
                                                                     
*                     INPUTE FILE'S STATUS                           
                                                                     
 01  FS-INSERTEMP                     PIC X(2).                      
     88  FS-INSERTEMP-OK              VALUE '00'.                    
     88  FS-INSERTEMP-END             VALUE '10'.                    
                                                                     
 01  SUBPROGRAM                       PIC X(8).                      
 01  WS-DATE                          PIC X(10).                     
                                                                     
 01  JSONDOC                          PIC X(13000) VALUE SPACES. 
 01  JSONDOC2                         PIC X(13000) VALUE SPACES. 
                                                                  
 01  COUNT1                           PIC 9(5). 
 01  COUNT2                           PIC 9(5). 
 01  COUNT3                           PIC 9(5). 
 01  COUNT4                           PIC 9(5) USAGE COMP-5. 
                                                                  
 01  WS-EMPLIST. 
      02 WS-EMPLIST-TABLE OCCURS 30. 
         03 EMPID                     PIC 9(8). 
         03 PASSW                     PIC X(8). 
         03 FIRSTNAME                 PIC X(30). 
         03 LASTNAME                  PIC X(30). 
         03 ADDRE                     PIC X(100). 
         03 CITY                      PIC X(50). 
         03 ZIPCODE                   PIC X(15). 
         03 TELEPHONE                 PIC X(10). 
         03 EMAIL                     PIC X(100). 
         03 ADMINDATE                 PIC X(10). 
         03 SALARY                    PIC 9(6)V9(2). 
         03 DEPTID                    PIC 9(9). 
                                                                  
*----------------* 
 LINKAGE SECTION. 
*----------------* 
                                                                  
 01  LS-EMPLIST. 
      02 LS-EMPLIST-TABLE OCCURS 30. 
         03 LS-EMPID              PIC X(8). 
         03 LS-FIRSTNAME. 
            04 LS-FIRSTNAME_L     PIC 9(4) USAGE COMP. 
            04 LS-FIRSTNAME_T     PIC X(30). 
         03 LS-LASTNAME. 
            04 LS-LASTNAME_L      PIC 9(4) USAGE COMP. 
            04 LS-LASTNAME_T      PIC X(30). 
         03 LS-ADDRE.                                               
            04 LS-ADDRE_L         PIC 9(4) USAGE COMP.              
            04 LS-ADDRE_T         PIC X(100).                       
         03 LS-CITY.                                                
            04 LS-CITY_L          PIC 9(4) USAGE COMP.              
            04 LS-CITY_T          PIC X(50).                        
         03 LS-ZIPCODE.                                             
            04 LS-ZIPCODE_L       PIC 9(4) USAGE COMP.              
            04 LS-ZIPCODE_T       PIC X(15).                        
         03 LS-TELEPHONE.                                           
            04 LS-TELEPHONE_L     PIC 9(4) USAGE COMP.              
            04 LS-TELEPHONE_T     PIC X(10).

            04 LS-EMAIL_T         PIC X(100).

         03 LS-DEPTID             PIC 9(9) USAGE COMP.              
                                                                    
****************************************************************    
*      PROCEDURE DIVISION WITH LINKAGE SECTION                 *    
****************************************************************    
                                                                    
 PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LS-EMPLIST.                               
                                                                    
 MAIN-PARA.                                                         
                                                                    
     PERFORM 0100-OPEN-FILE.                                        
     PERFORM 0200-READ-PROCESS.                                     
     PERFORM 0300-CRYPT-PASS VARYING COUNT1 FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL       
                                 COUNT1 > 30                        
     PERFORM 0400-END-FILE                                          
                                                                    
     GOBACK.                                                        
                                                                    
*****************************************************************   
* 0100-OPEN-FILE.                                               * 
*                                                               * 
* IT OPENS THE FILE TO PUT THE ENCRYPTED PASSWORD.              * 
***************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0100-OPEN-FILE. 
                                                                  
     OPEN INPUT INSERTEMP 
                                                                  
     IF NOT FS-INSERTEMP-OK 
        DISPLAY 'FILE OPENING ERROR' 
        DISPLAY 'FILE WILL NOT BE READ' 
        DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' FS-INSERTEMP 
        GOBACK 
     END-IF. 
                                                                  
************************************************************** 
* 0200-READ-PROCESS.                                         * 
*                                                            * 
* IT READS THE JSON FILE AND MOVE THE DATA TO A TABLE TO SEND* 
* THE CONVERT DATA TO A MAIN INSERT PROGRAM                  * 
************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0200-READ-PROCESS. 
                                                                  
     READ INSERTEMP 
     END-READ 
     IF NOT FS-INSERTEMP-OK 
        DISPLAY 'READ ERROR: ' FS-INSERTEMP 
     END-IF 
                                                                  
     JSON PARSE IN-JSON INTO WS-EMPLIST 
        WITH DETAIL 
     END-JSON 
                                                                  
     PERFORM 0210-MOVE-TABLE VARYING COUNT1 FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL 
                                         COUNT1 > 30. 
                                                                  
************************************************************** 
* 0210-MOVE-TABLE.                                           * 
*                                                            * 
* IT ADAPTS THE DATA TO A DB2 FORMAT                         * 
************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0210-MOVE-TABLE. 
                                                                  
     IF EMPID(COUNT1) IS NUMERIC 
                                                                  
        ADD 10000000 TO EMPID(COUNT1) 
        MOVE EMPID(COUNT1) TO LS-EMPID(COUNT1) 
                                                                  
        MOVE FIRSTNAME(COUNT1) TO LS-FIRSTNAME_T(COUNT1) 
        INSPECT FIRSTNAME(COUNT1) TALLYING COUNT2 FOR ALL SPACES 
        COMPUTE COUNT3 = 30 - COUNT2 
        MOVE COUNT3 TO LS-FIRSTNAME_L(COUNT1) 
                                                                  
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT2 
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT3 
                                                                  
        MOVE LASTNAME(COUNT1) TO LS-LASTNAME_T(COUNT1) 
        INSPECT LASTNAME(COUNT1) TALLYING COUNT2 FOR ALL SPACES 
        COMPUTE COUNT3 = 30 - COUNT2 
        MOVE COUNT3 TO LS-LASTNAME_L(COUNT1) 
                                                                  
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT2 
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT3 
                                                                  
        MOVE ADDRE(COUNT1) TO LS-ADDRE_T(COUNT1) 
        INSPECT ADDRE(COUNT1) TALLYING COUNT2 FOR ALL SPACES 
        COMPUTE COUNT3 = 100 - COUNT2 + 5 
        MOVE COUNT3 TO LS-ADDRE_L(COUNT1) 
                                                                  
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT2 
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT3 
                                                                  
        MOVE CITY(COUNT1) TO LS-CITY_T(COUNT1) 
        INSPECT CITY(COUNT1) TALLYING COUNT2 FOR ALL SPACES 
        COMPUTE COUNT3 = 50 - COUNT2 
        MOVE COUNT3 TO LS-CITY_L(COUNT1) 
                                                                  
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT2 
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT3 
                                                                  
        MOVE ZIPCODE(COUNT1) TO LS-ZIPCODE_T(COUNT1) 
        INSPECT ZIPCODE(COUNT1) TALLYING COUNT2 FOR ALL SPACES 
        COMPUTE COUNT3 = 15 - COUNT2 
        MOVE COUNT3 TO LS-ZIPCODE_L(COUNT1) 
                                                                  
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT2 
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT3 
                                                                  
        MOVE TELEPHONE(COUNT1) TO LS-TELEPHONE_T(COUNT1) 
        INSPECT FIRSTNAME(COUNT1) TALLYING COUNT2 FOR ALL SPACES 
        COMPUTE COUNT3 = 10 - COUNT2 
        MOVE COUNT3 TO LS-TELEPHONE_L(COUNT1) 
                                                                  
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT2 
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT3 
                                                                  
        MOVE EMAIL(COUNT1) TO LS-EMAIL_T(COUNT1) 
        INSPECT EMAIL(COUNT1) TALLYING COUNT2 FOR ALL SPACES 
        COMPUTE COUNT3 = 100 - COUNT2 
        MOVE COUNT3 TO LS-EMAIL_L(COUNT1) 
                                                                  
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT2 
        MOVE 0 TO COUNT3 
                                                                  
        MOVE ADMINDATE(COUNT1)(6:3) TO WS-DATE(1:3) 
        MOVE ADMINDATE(COUNT1)(9:2) TO WS-DATE(4:2)                  
        MOVE '/' TO WS-DATE(6:1)                                     
        MOVE ADMINDATE(COUNT1)(1:4) TO WS-DATE(7:4)                  
        MOVE WS-DATE TO ADMINDATE(COUNT1)                            
        MOVE ADMINDATE(COUNT1) TO LS-ADMIDATE(COUNT1)                
        MOVE SALARY(COUNT1) TO LS-SALARY(COUNT1)                     
        MOVE DEPTID(COUNT1) TO LS-DEPTID(COUNT1)                     
                                                                     
     END-IF.                                                         
                                                                     
*************************************************************        
* 0300-CRYPT-PASS.                                          *        
*                                                           *        
* IT CALLS THE ENCRYPTATION PROGRAM TO STORE THE PASSWORD   *        
*************************************************************        
                                                                     
 0300-CRYPT-PASS.                                                    
                                                                     
     IF EMPID(COUNT1) IS NUMERIC                                     
                                                                     
        MOVE 'CRYPTPGM' TO SUBPROGRAM                                
        CALL SUBPROGRAM USING PASSW(COUNT1), EMPID(COUNT1),          
                                  ADMINDATE(COUNT1)                  
                                                                     
     END-IF.                                                         
                                                                     
**************************************************************       
* 0400-END-FILE.                                             *       
*                                                            *       
* IT CLOSES THE JSON FILE.                                   *       
**************************************************************       
                                                                     
 0400-END-FILE.                                                      
                                                                     
     CLOSE INSERTEMP                                                 
                                                                     
     IF NOT FS-INSERTEMP-OK 
        DISPLAY 'ERROR TO CLOSE: ' FS-INSERTEMP 
     END-IF.

 01  WS-FLIGHT.                                                      
     02 WS-TABLE-FLIGHT OCCURS 31.                                   
        03 WS-FLIGHTID                    PIC S9(9) USAGE COMP.      
        03 WS-FLIGHTDATE.                                            
           04 WS-YEAR                     PIC 9(4).                  
           04 FILLER                      PIC X.                     
           04 WS-MONTHDATE                PIC 9(2).                  
           04 FILLER                      PIC X.                     
           04 WS-DAY                      PIC 9(2).                  
        03 WS-DEPTIME                     PIC X(8).                  
        03 WS-ARRTIME                     PIC X(8).                  
        03 WS-TOTPASS                     PIC S9(9) USAGE COMP.      
        03 WS-TOTBAGGA                    PIC S9(9) USAGE COMP.

****************************************************************

****************************************************************     
                                                                     
 01  MONTH                                PIC X(24)                  
                VALUE  '312831303130313130313031'.                   
                                                                     
 01  MONTH-RED REDEFINES MONTH.                                      
     02 WS-MONTH                          PIC 9(2) OCCURS 12.

****************************************************************

 01  COUNT2                            PIC 9(2).

****************************************************************

       VALUE  'CB1104CB1105CB2204CB2205CB3304CB3305CB4404CB4405'.    
                                                                     
 01  WS-FLIGHTNUM REDEFINES FLIGHTNUM-TABLE.                         
     02 WS-FLIGHTNUM-F                 PIC X(6) OCCURS 8.

****************************************************************

 PROCEDURE DIVISION.

        PERFORM 0300-INSERT-DATA

****************************************************************

*                                                              *

****************************************************************      
                                                                      
 0100-GET-DB2-DATA.                                                   
                                                                      
     MOVE WS-FLIGHTNUM-F(COUNT2) TO WS-FLIGHTNUM-DEF                  
                                                                      
     EXEC SQL                                                         
         SELECT *                                                     
         INTO :DCLFLIGHT                                              
         FROM FLIGHT                                                  
         WHERE FLIGHTNUM = :WS-FLIGHTNUM-DEF                          
*          AND (FLIGHTDATE = '01/09/2022')                            
     END-EXEC                                                         
                                                                      
     IF SQLCODE NOT = 0                                               
        DISPLAY 'EXTRACTION ERROR DATA'                               
        DISPLAY 'THE FLIGHTNUM IS: ' WS-FLIGHTNUM-F(COUNT2)           
        DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' SQLCODE                                     
        DISPLAY 'STATE: ' SQLSTATE                                    
     END-IF.                                                          
                                                                      
****************************************************************      
* 0200-DUPLICATE-DATA                                          *      
*                                                              *      
* IT GET THE INFROMATION FOR THE FIRST MONTH DAY AND DUPLICATE *    
* IT TO THE WHOLE MONTH.                                       *    
****************************************************************    
                                                                    
 0200-DUPLICATE-DATA.                                               
                                                                    
     MOVE DCLFLIGHT TO WS-TABLE-FLIGHT(1)                           
                                                                    
     PERFORM VARYING COUNT1 FROM 2 BY 1 UNTIL COUNT1 > WS-MONTH(9)  
                                                                    
        MOVE WS-TABLE-FLIGHT(1) TO WS-TABLE-FLIGHT(COUNT1)          
        MOVE COUNT1 TO WS-DAY(COUNT1)                               
        DISPLAY WS-FLIGHTDATE(COUNT1)                               
                                                                    
     END-PERFORM.                                                   
                                                                    
****************************************************************    
* 0300-INSERT-DATA                                             *    
*                                                              *    
* IT PUT THE NEW DUPLICATE DATA INTO THE DB2 TABLE             *    
****************************************************************    
                                                                    
 0300-INSERT-DATA.                                                  
                                                                    
     PERFORM VARYING COUNT1 FROM 2 BY 1 UNTIL COUNT1 > WS-MONTH(9)  
                                                                    
        MOVE WS-TABLE-FLIGHT(COUNT1) TO DCLFLIGHT                   
                                                                    
        EXEC SQL                                                    
            INSERT INTO FLIGHT (FLIGHTDATE, DEPTIME, ARRTIME,       
                   TOTPASS,TOTBAGGA, FLIGHTNUM, SHIFTID,            
                   AIRPLANEID, AIRPORTDEP, AIRPORTARR)              
            VALUES (:FLIGHTDATE, :DEPTIME, :ARRTIME, :TOTPASS,      
                    :TOTBAGGA, :FLIGHTNUM, :SHIFTID,                
                    :AIRPLANEID, :AIRPORTDEP, :AIRPORTARR)          
        END-EXEC                                                    
                                                         
        IF SQLCODE NOT = 0 
           DISPLAY 'EXTRACTION ERROR DATA' 
           DISPLAY 'IN COUNTER: ' COUNT1 
           DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' SQLCODE 
           DISPLAY 'STATE: ' SQLSTATE 
        END-IF 
                                                         
     END-PERFORM.

        PERFORM 0210-CONVERTION-XML-DB2

     END-PERFORM.

 0210-CONVERTION-XML-DB2. 
                                                                  
     MOVE FIRSTNAME(COUNT1) TO PA-FIRSTNAME_TEXT

 DATA DIVISION.

****************************************************************

 FILE SECTION.

 FD PASSENGER-FILE RECORDING MODE IS F.

 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

****************************************************************

****************************************************************
                                                                
  01  COUNT1                      PIC 9(5) VALUE 1.

****************************************************************

     88 FS-PASSENGER-FILE-OK                VALUE '00'.

****************************************************************

 01 XML-DOC                      PIC X(25000) VALUE SPACES. 
                                                                  
*----------------* 
 LINKAGE SECTION. 
*----------------* 
                                                                  
 01  PASSENGER-LIST.

        03 FIRSTNAME             PIC X(30). 
        03 LASTNAME              PIC X(30).

*           PROCEDURE DIVISION WITH LINKAGE                    * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 PROCEDURE DIVISION USING PASSENGER-LIST. 
                                                                  
     PERFORM 0100-OPEN-FILE. 
     PERFORM 0200-READ-FILE. 
     PERFORM 0300-CONVERT-XML. 
     PERFORM 0400-CLOSE-FILE. 
                                                                
     GOBACK. 
                                                                
****************************************************************
* 0100-OPEN-FILE.                                              *
*                                                              *
* IT OPEN THE FILE XML WITH THE PASSENGERS INFORMATION         *
****************************************************************
                                                                
 0100-OPEN-FILE. 
                                                                
     OPEN INPUT PASSENGER-FILE. 
                                                                
     IF NOT FS-PASSENGER-FILE-OK 
        DISPLAY 'THE FILE COULD NOT BE OPEN' 
        DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' FS-PASSENGER-FILE 
     ELSE 
        DISPLAY 'OPEN OK' 
     END-IF. 
                                                                
****************************************************************
* 0200-READ-FILE.                                              *
*                                                              *
* IT READ THE FILE INTO THE TABLE 'PASSENGER-LIST'             *
****************************************************************
                                                                
 0200-READ-FILE. 
                                                                
     READ PASSENGER-FILE 
     END-READ. 
                                                                
     IF NOT FS-PASSENGER-FILE-OK 
        DISPLAY 'THE PROGRAM COULD NOT READ THE FILE' 
        DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' FS-PASSENGER-FILE 
     ELSE 
        DISPLAY 'READ OK' 
     END-IF. 
                                                                
****************************************************************
* 0300-CONVERT-XML.                                            *
*                                                              *
* IT MAKE DE PARSE PROCESS TO CONVERT XML IN COBOL VARIABLE    *
****************************************************************
                                                                
 0300-CONVERT-XML. 
                                                                
     MOVE FUNCTION DISPLAY-OF(FUNCTION NATIONAL-OF( 
                    PASSENGER-XML 1208) 1047) TO XML-DOC 
                                                                
     XML PARSE XML-DOC PROCESSING PROCEDURE 
                            0310-HANDLER-XML 
*       ON EXCEPTION 
*          DISPLAY 'XML ERROR: ' XML-CODE 
*       NOT ON EXCEPTION 
*          DISPLAY 'XML PARSE SUCCESSFULLY' 
     END-XML. 
                                                                
****************************************************************
* 0310-HANDLER-XML                                             *
*                                                              *
* IT IS THE PROCEDURE TO ACCOMPLISH THE XML PARSE PROCESS      *
****************************************************************
                                                                
 0310-HANDLER-XML. 
                                                                
     EVALUATE XML-EVENT 
        WHEN 'START-OF-ELEMENT' 
            MOVE SPACES TO XML-HEAD 
            MOVE XML-TEXT TO XML-HEAD 
        WHEN 'CONTENT-CHARACTERS' 
            EVALUATE XML-HEAD 
               WHEN 'FIRSTNAME' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO FIRSTNAME(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY FIRSTNAME(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'LASTNAME' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO LASTNAME(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY LASTNAME(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'ADDRE' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO ADDRE(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY ADDRE(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'CITY' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO CITY(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY CITY(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'COUNTRY' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO COUNTRY(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNTRY(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'ZIPCODE' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO ZIPCODE(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY ZIPCODE(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'TELEPHONE' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO TELEPHONE(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY TELEPHONE(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'EMAIL' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO EMAIL(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY EMAIL(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                  ADD 1 TO COUNT1 
                                                                 
            END-EVALUATE 
                                                                 
     END-EVALUATE. 
                                                                 
**************************************************************** 
* 0400-CLOSE-FILE                                              * 
*                                                              * 
* IT CLOSE THE FILE 'PASSENGER-FILE'                           * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                 
 0400-CLOSE-FILE. 
                                                                 
     CLOSE PASSENGER-FILE 
                                                                 
     IF NOT FS-PASSENGER-FILE-OK 
        DISPLAY 'THE FILE COULD NOT BE OPEN' 
        DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' FS-PASSENGER-FILE 
     ELSE 
        DISPLAY 'CLOSE OK' 
     END-IF.
